name: WHOATC
description: ATC drug classification. The canonical authority selected for the WHOATC Source is the WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology's ATC/DDD Index. The offline build-who-update command consumes the hash-pinned WHOCC crawl snapshot and a target environment's complete BEFORE export to create an audited WHOCC-only update; the legacy BioPortal/UMLS build and its older bundle remain historical comparison artifacts.
copyright: WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology. ATC classification index with DDDs, 2026. Oslo, Norway, 2026. Source: https://atcddd.fhi.no/atc_ddd_index/. Owner decision: use the public index and provide this attribution; no open redistribution licence is asserted here. This is not a legal opinion.

properties.description: OCL concept class derived from the WHOCC ATC level: Root for the synthetic root, Chapter (level 1), Group (level 2), Subgroup (levels 3-4), Code (level 5). Not a WHOCC field.
1-5, derived from the five-level WHOCC ATC hierarchy recorded in the crawl snapshot; the public Index does not supply a separate numeric property.
Y for WHOCC levels 1-4 (classification groups), N for level 5 (a chemical substance), derived from the five-level classification.

filters.description: Focuses the concept list on level-5 chemical substances rather than the synthetic root and classification groups.
Focuses the concept list on the 14 top-level anatomical/pharmacological groups.
